title: Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Service Standards Card: Ready Times, Promise Dates and Backorder Limits
content:
**Ridgeline Orders & Delivery promises each order a ready or delivery date according to its fulfillment program.** Shipped and scheduled orders are promised a number of calendar days from the order date; an in-stock pickup order is ready within a number of hours after it is placed; and an item may stay on backorder only a set number of calendar days past its promised date before the order is cancelled and refunded.

| Fulfillment program | Days from order to promised delivery or ready date (calendar days) | Hours after placement by which an in-stock pickup order is ready | Days an item may stay on backorder past its promised date (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | 5 | 0 | 14 |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 0 | 2 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | 7 | 0 | 14 |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | 0 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | 7 | 0 | 21 |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | 5 | 0 | 21 |

A backorder figure of 0 means that limit does not apply to the program.

### Dates worked from the card (illustrative order dates)

- **Promise date.** A Ridgeline Ship to Home order dated 2026-03-02 is promised for 2026-03-07, five calendar days later. The same order date under Ridgeline Ship to Store or Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery gives 2026-03-09, seven calendar days later.
- **Pickup ready time.** A Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store order of in-stock items placed at 10:15 is ready by 12:15, two hours later.
- **Backorder limit.** For a Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery order promised for 2026-03-09, an item still on backorder on 2026-03-30 has stayed 21 days past the promised date, which the 21-day limit allows; on 2026-03-31 it has stayed 22 days, which is more than the limit.
